verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships some built-in event-driven automation: email alerts when daily monitoring finds failing tests, customizable notifications for recurring tasks, recurring vendor reviews by risk level with Jira/Slack tasks and notifications, and follow-up tickets created automatically from access-review decisions. These are fixed, vendor-defined behaviors, though; nothing shows users can author their own event→action rules. missing for 10: a user-configurable rule or workflow builder (custom triggers, conditions and actions), outbound webhooks or event subscriptions, documentation of automation configuration, independent corroboration.
